name: Daily Email Report
description: Scheduled workflow that searches the web and sends daily email reports via SendGrid
explanation:
This workflow automates daily email reports by searching the web for information and sending results via SendGrid.

Key features:
- Schedule trigger: Runs automatically at specified time (default: daily at 18:00)
- Web Search tool: Searches specific domains for relevant information
- SendGrid integration: Sends formatted email with AI-generated content
- Variable support: Use {{context.aiResponse}} in email body

Use cases:
- Daily news digest
- Stock price alerts
- Security vulnerability reports
- Competitor monitoring
- Industry trend summaries

Setup required:
1. Configure SendGrid connection in Connections
2. Set recipient email address in SendGrid node
3. Customize system message for your use case
4. Adjust schedule time and timezone
5. (Optional) Specify domains for web search
